description: Just Use Wheels: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by Just Use Wheels. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Central and Western District, Hong Kong, China. Coverage: Central and Western District, Hong Kong, China. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed for this provider (Central and Western District, Hong Kong, China). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Attributions, Bike Allowed, Frequencies, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Shapes, Stops Wheelchair Accessibility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
